segments.name: Oncology Segment
segments.description: Precision oncology company developing small-molecule therapeutics for patients with genetically defined or biomarker-driven cancers, managed and resourced on a consolidated basis.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in the U.S. and has one operating segment that is managed on a consolidated basis .

revenueModel.text: Revenue comes mainly from Gilead under a license and collaboration agreement rather than from product sales.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's revenues are primarily generated through its license and collaboration agreement with Gilead.

changes.text: In 2024 the company discontinued a development program after toxicity in dose escalation.
changes.evidence: In May 2024, we announced the discontinuation of TNG348, a USP1 inhibitor, due to toxicity observed in the dose escalation portion of our Phase 1/2 clinical trial.

changes.text: In 2024 the company stopped enrollment in a clinical trial for portfolio prioritization.
changes.evidence: In November 2024, we announced we stopped enrollment of the TNG908 Phase 1/2 clinical trial due to insufficient brain exposure for clinical activity in GBM patients and portfolio prioritization.
